attributes.description: This layer shows the location of bike lanes in the City of Tumwater. It only shows bike lanes that are owned and maintained by the City. Bike lanes are shown in the center of the bike lane.
attributes.licenseInfo: This dataset was compiled from a variety of sources of differing accuracies and is a work in progress. Data may be missing or incorrect. If this dataset is used, it should be used with caution. This is not survey-grade data and should be used for planning purposes only, and verified in the field.

prcStep.stepDesc: Bike lanes were originally digitized based on 2018 3-inch aerial photos. Every year or as needed, they are updated based on new aerial photography.
prcStep.stepRat: Data needs to be QC'd with new aerials to incorporate any changes.

dataLineage.statement: This layer is updated as new bike lanes are added to streets.

report.measDesc: Lines represent centerlines of bike lanes, based on visual digitization of 2018 3-inch aerials. Data has been QC'd with each new aerial photo and new bike lanes digitized based on aerial photos.
Bike lanes have been updated for main roads, but have not been QC'd for other roads.
